fields.label: Pick up orders from Gmail
fields.description: Off until the Google steps are done. Read-only: the system never sends, labels or deletes mail.

fields.label: Gmail label
fields.description: Only mail under this label is read. Create the label in Gmail and apply it with a filter or by hand.

fields.label: Only these senders
fields.description: Addresses or @domains, separated by commas or lines. Blank = anyone whose mail carries the label.

fields.label: Also pick up from these senders
fields.description: Addresses or domains (plaza-network.com), separated by commas or lines. Their mail is read even without the label.

fields.label: Look back (days)
fields.description: Older mail is ignored, so the first run does not pull in the whole label.

fields.label: Delivery date: days after the email
fields.description: Draft orders get this delivery date; change it on the order.

fields.label: Google refresh token
fields.description: From the one-time sign-in on your own computer (deploy/gmail_orders.md). Read-only Gmail access.
